extracted.name: Orange Romaine Salad
extracted.description: Romaine lettuce and orange slices are tossed with a light honey vinaigrette.
ingredient_lines: 1 large head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: In a small container with a tight-fitting lid, combine the vinegar, oil, honey, salt, pepper and green onion. Close the lid, and shake vigorously to blend.
Place the romaine lettuce into a large serving bowl. Sprinkle with dressing and toss to coat. Add orange slices and toss gently. Serve immediately.
